scope: Current V1 automatic prefix cache design, metrics and security guidance.

claims.claim: Prefix Cache block hashes include the block token IDs and preceding prefix context so that contextually different blocks are not treated as identical.
claims.notes: Multimodal inputs may add extra hash material.

claims.claim: The V1 cache assigns a block hash when the block is full and manages reusable blocks with reference counts and an eviction queue.
claims.locator: KVCacheBlock data structure, Block Allocation and Eviction
claims.notes: An incomplete tail block should not be described as an already-complete reusable prefix block.

claims.claim: V1 exposes prefix_cache_hits and prefix_cache_queries counters for measuring cached and queried token counts.
claims.notes: Interpret counters over the same time window and according to the current metric semantics.

claims.claim: cache_salt is mixed into the first KV block hash to isolate prefix cache reuse and mitigate timing side-channel inference in multi-tenant deployments.
claims.locator: Prefix Cache Timing Side-Channel Mitigation / Cache Salting
claims.notes: This is one isolation control, not a replacement for authentication or network security.
